title: Spike: Gaps and Acceptance Criteria
purpose: Identify missing specification detail and confirm acceptance criteria are testable.

questions.label: Missing Specifications
questions.prompt: Which areas of the product are underspecified? List each gap and what decision is needed.

questions.label: AC Coverage
questions.prompt: Are the acceptance criteria in the spec sufficient to verify the product? If not, what is missing?

questions.label: Edge Cases
questions.prompt: What edge cases or failure modes are not addressed in the current spec?
